Task Description:
I've set up an machine learning experiment tracking repository under /app/data/ containing a 52-byte Big-Endian binary lineage ledger at /app/data/lineage_graph.bin, a 64-byte Big-Endian binary checkpoint dossier stream at /app/data/checkpoint_dossier.bin, and provenance reconstruction policies at /app/data/provenance_rules.yaml. Your goal is to write an experiment provenance repair utility at /app/solution/solve.sh that decodes the binary lineage and checkpoint records, validates IEEE 802.3 CRC32 checksums, imputes broken parent run IDs via binary checkpoint lineage matching, and outputs a canonical experiment provenance report at /app/output/provenance_report.json.

The binary lineage ledger at /app/data/lineage_graph.bin begins with a 12-byte header containing magic bytes EXPRV, a uint16 version, a uint16 record count, and 3 reserved bytes, followed by 52-byte record entries. Each record consists of a 48-byte payload containing a 16-byte run_id string, 16-byte parent_run_id string, 8-byte experiment_hash string, uint16 status_code, uint32 execution_timestamp, and 2 reserved bytes, followed by a 4-byte IEEE 802.3 CRC32 checksum over the payload. Read each binary record, verify its CRC32 checksum, and discard any record failing validation as corrupted (such as run-exp-005).

Next, parse the binary checkpoint dossier stream at /app/data/checkpoint_dossier.bin, which begins with a 12-byte header with magic CKPTR followed by 64-byte records containing a 16-byte run_id, 18-byte input_checkpoint, 18-byte output_checkpoint, 4-byte IEEE 802.3 CRC32 checksum over the 52-byte payload, and 8 reserved bytes. Verify CRC32 checksums for each record and discard invalid entries (such as run-exp-005). For valid runs with missing or broken parent_run_id links (such as run-exp-003), impute parent_run_id by matching input_checkpoint against valid output_checkpoint hashes, updating parent links and calculating topological tree depth levels.

Finally, write the repaired provenance report to /app/output/provenance_report.json formatted with two-space indentation. The output JSON must contain top-level status set to SUCCESS, a summary object containing total_records, valid_records, repaired_lineages, and corrupted_records_excluded count metrics, and a provenance_tree array of objects containing run_id, parent_run_id, depth, checkpoint_hash, and status. Ensure directory structures exist and that your repair tool executes cleanly offline without network calls.
